units.trigger: A hyperscaler reportedly considers a very large compute-lease deal with an AI lab.
uncertainty_notes: The report is sourced to a news item and terms are limited.

action_horizon.action: Validate the read-through with subsequent supplier earnings and demand disclosures.

units.evidence_sought: Underlying demand commentary, shipment mix, ASPs, margin performance, and supplier read-through.
units.falsifier: Shipment, ASP, or margin drivers do not appear in supplier results.
units.inference: Estimate revisions at a leading optical company can be a useful ecosystem signal when the claimed drivers map to upstream suppliers.

raw_codes.label: Ecosystem read-through
raw_codes.rationale: Uses a leading downstream company's revisions to assess related component demand.

raw_codes.label: Demand-driver mapping
raw_codes.rationale: Maps volume and mix changes through to upstream inputs.

units.trigger: A sector leader receives large multi-year earnings-estimate revisions driven by optical volume, ASP, and margin assumptions.
uncertainty_notes: The analyst estimates and supplier mappings may not fully transfer across companies.

action_horizon.action: Assess arbitrage feasibility before the conversion window opens.

units.evidence_sought: Conversion date, eligible float, conversion mechanics, costs, borrow, and local-share liquidity.
units.falsifier: Conversion is restricted, uneconomic, or the premium persists despite available arbitrage.
units.inference: New convertibility can enable arbitrage and compress a premium, though the price adjustment may occur in either market.

raw_codes.label: Corporate-action timing
raw_codes.rationale: The expected adjustment is linked to a dated conversion event.

raw_codes.label: Arbitrage catalyst
raw_codes.rationale: Convertibility creates the mechanism for premium compression.

units.trigger: An ADR trades at a large premium to locally listed shares before conversion becomes available.
uncertainty_notes: Actual conversion frictions and arbitrage capacity are unspecified.

action_horizon.action: Monitor whether constraints persist and are followed by committed capex.

units.evidence_sought: Utilization, allocation limits, service availability, and announced capex budgets.
units.falsifier: Capacity constraints ease without incremental investment or demand weakens.
units.inference: Persistent capacity constraint is a demand signal that can support continued infrastructure spending.

raw_codes.label: Capacity-constraint demand signal
raw_codes.rationale: Connects observed scarcity to likely infrastructure response.

units.trigger: Frontier AI models are reported to be capacity constrained amid strong demand.
uncertainty_notes: The degree and cause of capacity constraint are not quantified.

action_horizon.action: Use the map to prioritize diligence on the longest and most AI-relevant constraints.

units.evidence_sought: Lead-time sources, product specificity, end-market mix, capacity additions, and order cancellation rates.
units.falsifier: Lead times normalize, shortages are confined to low-value products, or orders cancel.
units.inference: Map bottlenecks by component and lead time rather than treating all electronics demand as equally constrained.

raw_codes.label: Lead-time bottleneck map
raw_codes.rationale: Catalogues observable supply constraints by component category.

raw_codes.label: End-market segmentation
raw_codes.rationale: Recognizes commodity and AI-data-center demand have different implications.

units.trigger: Reported lead times show shortages across substrates, boards, materials, and passive components.
uncertainty_notes: Lead times are sourced secondhand and vary by specification.

action_horizon.action: Validate moves against signed contracts and ARR conversion.

units.evidence_sought: Contract quality, ARR guidance, lease duration, customer credit, and whether peers share the same catalyst.
units.falsifier: Guidance, contract execution, or utilization fails to support the recovery.
units.inference: A cluster recovery can indicate renewed appetite for the group, but price momentum should be separated from company-specific execution.

raw_codes.label: Contract-driven rerating
raw_codes.rationale: New contracts and revised ARR expectations are identified as catalysts.

units.trigger: Several AI-cloud and colocation companies rise following contract and ARR catalysts.
uncertainty_notes: The peer price moves do not establish common fundamentals.

action_horizon.action: Treat the filing as a sentiment catalyst unless it documents a new position.

units.evidence_sought: Filing dates, security types, share counts, purchase dates, and any incremental investment.
units.falsifier: The filing shows material new purchases rather than pre-existing securities.
units.inference: Separate sentiment value of a newly visible holder from genuinely new capital or changed ownership.

raw_codes.label: Regulatory-filing verification
raw_codes.rationale: Uses a primary filing to establish ownership facts.

raw_codes.label: Novelty-versus-sentiment distinction
raw_codes.rationale: The market reaction can differ from the economic newness of the information.

units.trigger: A regulatory filing discloses a strategic investor's beneficial ownership, but the position largely predates the disclosure.
uncertainty_notes: The filing may not disclose all economic terms or later changes.

action_horizon.action: Wait for event disclosures; distinguish sector confirmation from company-specific validation.

units.evidence_sought: Explicit CPO commitment, architecture details, optical-engine supplier identity, and formal supply-chain confirmation.
units.falsifier: The roadmap excludes CPO, uses a different architecture, or does not include the inferred supplier.
units.inference: A thematic confirmation is less valuable than direct evidence that a particular upstream supplier is in the program.

raw_codes.label: Event-driven confirmation
raw_codes.rationale: The thesis is held pending a scheduled disclosure.

raw_codes.label: Direct-supply-chain evidence
raw_codes.rationale: Formal confirmation is prioritized over inferred relationships.

units.trigger: An upcoming product event may disclose a scale-up optical-interconnect roadmap and suppliers.
uncertainty_notes: Supplier relationships are described as possible rather than confirmed.

action_horizon.action: Examine financing structure and eventual cash collection, not just announced order value.

units.evidence_sought: Investment terms, purchase obligations, credit support, arm's-length economics, and customer funding.
units.falsifier: The buyer cannot fund purchases or contractual demand is materially reduced.
units.inference: Paired investment and procurement can secure demand but creates circular-financing and counterparty-risk questions.

raw_codes.label: Vendor-financing scrutiny
raw_codes.rationale: Supplier capital is connected to customer purchasing capacity.

units.trigger: A chip supplier invests in an AI customer that simultaneously commits to buy large volumes of its chips.
uncertainty_notes: The investment and purchase agreement terms are not provided.

action_horizon.action: Prioritize the earnings call and subsequent capex guidance over headline EPS.

units.evidence_sought: Forward capex guidance, networking share of spend, cloud demand commentary, and supplier orders.
units.falsifier: Capex or networking spend is cut, or cloud growth/margins reverse materially.
units.inference: Hyperscaler operating results and capex commentary are leading read-throughs for AI infrastructure suppliers.

raw_codes.label: Hyperscaler earnings read-through
raw_codes.rationale: Downstream cloud metrics are used to assess upstream AI demand.

raw_codes.label: Operational-metric prioritization
raw_codes.rationale: Cloud revenue, margin, and capex are emphasized over EPS noise.

units.trigger: A hyperscaler's earnings show cloud-growth acceleration, margin expansion, and sustained capex.
uncertainty_notes: Supplier benefit depends on spend mix and competitive allocation.

action_horizon.action: Track usage and capacity indicators alongside capex plans.

units.evidence_sought: User retention, token volume, monetization, utilization, and resulting infrastructure budgets.
units.falsifier: Usage growth slows sharply, monetization fails, or capacity is abundant without new capex.
units.inference: Rapid usage growth with constrained compute supports the case for continued capex, conditional on durable demand.

raw_codes.label: Usage-to-capex chain
raw_codes.rationale: Links end-user growth and compute usage to infrastructure demand.

units.trigger: AI-product users and token throughput grow rapidly while capacity allocations tighten.
uncertainty_notes: User and token metrics do not by themselves establish profitability or future capex.

action_horizon.action: Update demand expectations and verify mix in management commentary.

units.evidence_sought: Capex mix, procurement timing, utilization, and corroborating supplier demand.
units.falsifier: Capex is later cut, reallocated away from infrastructure, or not converted into orders.
units.inference: An upward capex revision is a strong demand read-through for upstream AI infrastructure, especially if spending mix includes relevant categories.

raw_codes.label: Capex-guidance revision
raw_codes.rationale: Raised spending guidance is the direct demand catalyst.

raw_codes.label: Upstream read-through
raw_codes.rationale: Hyperscaler budgets are used to evaluate suppliers.

units.trigger: A hyperscaler raises current-year capex guidance and signals further increase next year.
uncertainty_notes: The post does not provide detailed capex allocation.

action_horizon.action: Research newly named component categories and verify capacity-to-unit-ramp conversion.

units.evidence_sought: Production capacity, actual unit ramps, supplier qualification, component content, and contract evidence.
units.falsifier: Humanoid production targets slip or supply-chain investment does not convert into orders.
units.inference: New product categories can create upstream opportunities, but executive TAM conviction is weaker than production and procurement evidence.

raw_codes.label: End-product-to-supplier mapping
raw_codes.rationale: Maps stated production ambitions through to components and supplier opportunities.

raw_codes.label: Management-commentary weighting
raw_codes.rationale: Uses transcript statements while retaining execution verification.

units.trigger: A potential humanoid-robotics ramp is paired with management comments on new supply chains and supplier categories.
uncertainty_notes: Production targets and supplier opportunities are not firm procurement commitments.

action_horizon.action: Track contract terms and realized pricing across the supply chain.

units.evidence_sought: Contract enforceability, take-or-pay terms, capacity, pricing persistence, and end-demand.
units.falsifier: LTAs are canceled or pricing and utilization weaken materially.
units.inference: Broad LTAs across bottleneck categories can signal durable procurement urgency, but do not eliminate cyclical or counterparty risk.

raw_codes.label: Bottleneck-contract validation
raw_codes.rationale: Committed demand is used as evidence of scarcity value.

raw_codes.label: Contract-risk caveat
raw_codes.rationale: The conclusion remains conditional on enforceability and execution.

units.trigger: CPU price increases and multi-year supply agreements emerge across several AI infrastructure components.
uncertainty_notes: The breadth and terms of reported LTAs are not independently detailed.

action_horizon.action: Use the checks as a monitoring signal and seek official confirmation.

contradiction_notes: The checks push back on recent third-party delay reports.
units.evidence_sought: Official roadmap, partner schedules, supplier lead times, and independent corroboration.
units.falsifier: Official disclosures or delivery data confirm material CPO supply-chain delays.
units.inference: Channel checks can update the probability of a delay but should not override formal company or partner guidance.

raw_codes.label: Informal-versus-official evidence
raw_codes.rationale: The post explicitly distinguishes channel commentary from guidance.

raw_codes.label: Conflicting-timeline reconciliation
raw_codes.rationale: Channel checks are assessed against third-party delay claims.

units.trigger: Informal channel checks challenge public reports of CPO scale-up delays.
uncertainty_notes: The channel checks are informal and anonymized.

action_horizon.action: Model pluggable and CPO paths separately and monitor capacity bottlenecks.

units.evidence_sought: Architecture adoption by customer, addressable-market split, manufacturing constraints, and acquisition execution.
units.falsifier: Pluggable demand is displaced materially faster than stated or capacity ceases to constrain supply.
units.inference: Avoid zero-sum TAM assumptions: multiple architectures may coexist, with near-term value concentrated in established products and long-term upside in newer ones.

raw_codes.label: Architecture coexistence
raw_codes.rationale: Frames competing technologies as potentially complementary over different horizons.

raw_codes.label: Near-term versus long-term TAM
raw_codes.rationale: Separates established-market demand from the longer CPO opportunity.

units.trigger: A component CEO states that legacy pluggables will coexist with newer optical architectures while capacity remains constrained.
uncertainty_notes: The commentary is one executive's view and M&A speculation is unconfirmed.

action_horizon.action: Reassess the platform's competitive moat and substitute options if a split advances.

units.evidence_sought: Contract terms, exclusivity, deployment economics, customer ownership, and alternative partner availability.
units.falsifier: The partnership remains durable, noncompetitive, and economically favorable.
units.inference: A distribution partnership can become strategically adverse when the supplier gains scale and competes for the end customer.

raw_codes.label: Partner-to-competitor risk
raw_codes.rationale: Maps supplier scale into potential disintermediation of the distributor.

units.trigger: A platform's autonomous-driving partner may split while becoming a potential direct competitor.
uncertainty_notes: The reported split and competitive outcome are not certain.

action_horizon.action: Evaluate financing exposure separately from gross announced demand.
action_horizon.horizon: Financing close through lease and purchase execution

units.evidence_sought: Guarantee exposure, financing terms, collateral, customer creditworthiness, and actual chip cash flows.
units.falsifier: Financing cannot close, guarantees create losses, or customer purchases fail to materialize.
units.inference: Vendor-supported infrastructure financing may expand near-term demand while increasing circularity and credit risk.

raw_codes.label: Circular-financing risk
raw_codes.rationale: The supplier's financial support is linked to demand for its own products.

units.trigger: A supplier reportedly backstops a customer's very large data-center financing while the customer may buy the supplier's chips.
uncertainty_notes: The reported agreements and guarantee details are incomplete.

action_horizon.action: Wait for final regulatory action and assess beneficiary capacity.

units.evidence_sought: Final rule text, scope, effective date, enforcement, domestic capacity, and affected competitors.
units.falsifier: The restriction is not adopted, is narrow, or domestic suppliers cannot meet demand.
units.inference: A policy barrier can improve domestic competitors' relative position only if it is enacted and meaningfully limits substitutes.

raw_codes.label: Regulatory protection catalyst
raw_codes.rationale: The policy action is the mechanism for altered competition.

raw_codes.label: Implementation test
raw_codes.rationale: Final scope and domestic execution determine whether the read-through holds.

units.trigger: A proposed import restriction could limit foreign humanoid and quadruped robots.
uncertainty_notes: The post describes a prospective policy action, not final regulation.

action_horizon.action: Use earnings and capex updates as confirmation points; avoid forecasting the exact recovery date.

units.evidence_sought: Revenue/EPS revisions, capex guidance, sector breadth, leverage data, and forthcoming earnings.
units.falsifier: Earnings revisions weaken or hyperscaler capex and demand indicators reverse.
units.inference: Separate short-term cross-asset deleveraging from the operating thesis by testing whether revenue acceleration and capex remain intact.

raw_codes.label: Fundamentals-versus-flow diagnosis
raw_codes.rationale: Tests operating acceleration against a liquidity-based explanation for price moves.

raw_codes.label: Earnings-confirmation horizon
raw_codes.rationale: Defers judgment to scheduled operational evidence.

units.trigger: Broad AI-linked equities fall despite reported earnings acceleration and raised hyperscaler capex.
uncertainty_notes: The deleveraging explanation and sector mappings are partly opinion-based.

action_horizon.action: Track funded milestones and direct procurement or qualification announcements.
action_horizon.horizon: Two to three years and beyond

units.evidence_sought: Award terms, R&D timeline, named partners, technology adoption, and supplier qualification.
units.falsifier: The program is not funded or does not translate into commercial CPO adoption or supplier orders.
units.inference: Targeted public funding can accelerate a technology ecosystem, but named-reference relationships are not equivalent to revenue commitments.

raw_codes.label: Public-R&D acceleration
raw_codes.rationale: Government funding is identified as a mechanism to shorten development timelines.

raw_codes.label: Reference-design limitation
raw_codes.rationale: Presentation references are distinguished from confirmed commercial relationships.

units.trigger: Government funding and an equity stake are announced for domestic CPO and silicon-photonics R&D.
uncertainty_notes: Supplier read-through rests partly on reference-design and presentation mentions.

action_horizon.action: Wait for chair commentary and update the rate-path assessment.

units.evidence_sought: Policy statement, chair commentary, forward guidance, inflation/employment data, and market-implied path.
units.falsifier: Forward guidance or subsequent data indicates materially tighter policy than priced.
units.inference: The unchanged decision removes one immediate downside catalyst, but the forward policy signal remains decisive.

raw_codes.label: Decision-versus-guidance sequencing
raw_codes.rationale: Separates the completed rate decision from the still-pending explanatory signal.

units.trigger: The central bank holds rates steady after markets had priced concern about a hike.
uncertainty_notes: The market's prior pricing and reaction are not quantified.

action_horizon.action: Monitor contract conversion and capacity utilization.

units.evidence_sought: Contract duration, deposit terms, committed volumes, supplier expansion plans, and whether the reservation converts to revenue.
units.falsifier: The deposit is refundable or capacity remains materially underutilized.
units.inference: Upfront capacity reservation is evidence of scarcity and raises supplier demand visibility.

raw_codes.label: Capacity-reservation agreement
raw_codes.rationale: Prepayment signals demand and constrains available supply.

raw_codes.label: Monitor conversion
raw_codes.rationale: Economic impact depends on shipment and revenue realization.

units.trigger: A customer prepays to reserve supplier capacity under a long-term agreement.
uncertainty_notes: Counterparty and commercial terms are redacted.

action_horizon.action: Track quarterly capex and capacity guidance across buyers.

units.evidence_sought: Capex guidance, free-cash-flow funding, capacity commentary, order/backlog data, and supplier lead times.
units.falsifier: Buyers cut capex materially, cancel orders, or report excess available capacity.
units.inference: Broad, funded demand supports downstream infrastructure and upstream component demand beyond a single buyer.

raw_codes.label: Hyperscaler capex to upstream demand
raw_codes.rationale: Buyer spending is used as a read-through to suppliers.

raw_codes.label: Operating-cash-funded capex
raw_codes.rationale: Funding source affects durability of spending.

units.trigger: Multiple major buyers sustain or raise capital-spending plans while reporting demand above available capacity.
uncertainty_notes: Management guidance can change and does not establish supplier-specific benefit.

action_horizon.action: Follow test revenue and production milestones before extrapolating volume demand.

contradiction_notes: Near-term acceleration coexists with no significant overall timeline pull-in.
units.evidence_sought: Revenue guidance revisions, purchase orders, production infrastructure, customer programs, and downstream component order timing.
units.falsifier: Revised revenue remains immaterial, production programs slip, or orders fail to progress beyond testing.
units.inference: Commercial adoption may be beginning, with test and equipment revenue appearing before higher-volume component demand.

raw_codes.label: Early commercialization signal
raw_codes.rationale: Guidance beat and production language indicate a move beyond R&D.

raw_codes.label: Test revenue precedes component volumes
raw_codes.rationale: The analysis sequences adoption through the supply chain.

units.trigger: Early-stage product revenue exceeds prior guidance and management cites production rather than only development activity.
uncertainty_notes: Management explicitly says the broader adoption timeline has not materially pulled in.

action_horizon.action: Separate forced-flow evidence from fundamental deterioration before acting.

contradiction_notes: The post acknowledges leverage and liquidity-management problems while treating the selloff as opportunity.
units.evidence_sought: Position leverage, forced-sale evidence, liquidity, hedging, fundamentals, and subsequent operating updates.
units.falsifier: The drawdown reveals impaired liquidity, broken hedges, or deteriorating operating fundamentals.
units.inference: A forced-deleveraging selloff can create an entry opportunity only if the fundamental thesis and financing remain intact.

raw_codes.label: Forced-flow versus fundamentals
raw_codes.rationale: Distinguishes mechanical selling from business impairment.

raw_codes.label: Leverage and liquidity check
raw_codes.rationale: These conditions determine whether the contrarian interpretation holds.

units.trigger: A sharp drawdown is associated with leverage-driven selling while the underlying thesis is asserted unchanged.
uncertainty_notes: The claim that selling overshot is an interpretation, not demonstrated evidence.

action_horizon.action: Validate whether supplier capacity expansion translates into revenue and margins.

units.evidence_sought: Buyer capex and reservation data, supplier backlog, capacity additions, revenue-per-capacity targets, and margin guidance.
units.falsifier: Buyer capacity demand weakens, supplier backlog falls, or expansion fails to deliver targeted utilization or margins.
units.inference: Aligned demand evidence across end market and supplier supports a supply-chain bottleneck thesis.

raw_codes.label: End-demand to upstream supplier
raw_codes.rationale: Connects buyer compute demand to substrate demand.

raw_codes.label: Scarcity-driven pricing and margin
raw_codes.rationale: The thesis depends on constrained supply improving supplier economics.

units.trigger: A large end-market buyer reports capacity shortages and higher capex while an upstream supplier reports backlog, expansion, and demand above supply.
uncertainty_notes: Projected ASP increases are not supported by reported contract terms.

action_horizon.action: Wait for design-win conversion and volume-production milestones.

contradiction_notes: The author revised an earlier, more optimistic ramp estimate.
units.evidence_sought: Design wins, partner projects, volume-production dates, qualification milestones, and current revenue contribution.
units.falsifier: Projects are cancelled, design wins do not reach volume production, or the technology shift does not create meaningful demand.
units.inference: Confirmed exposure validates strategic optionality, but revenue recognition should be timed to production ramps rather than announcement dates.

raw_codes.label: Management confirmation
raw_codes.rationale: Direct company commentary upgrades confidence in exposure.

raw_codes.label: Revenue-ramp timing
raw_codes.rationale: Management dates production after the near term.

units.trigger: Management confirms exposure to a future technology shift but gives a later production timeline than previously expected.
uncertainty_notes: Exposure does not quantify economic materiality.

action_horizon.action: Monitor for order announcements and first production shipments.

units.evidence_sought: Binding orders, production start, customer qualification, supplier financing use, and shipment timing.
units.falsifier: Production language is not followed by orders or the supplier’s planned mass production is delayed.
units.inference: A wording upgrade can signal increased commercialization probability, but volume timing remains contingent on orders.

raw_codes.label: Language upgrade
raw_codes.rationale: The move rests on a change in management wording.

raw_codes.label: Production-to-order bridge
raw_codes.rationale: Orders are expected after stated production readiness.

units.trigger: Company language changes from readiness to production for a supplier-linked program.
uncertainty_notes: The asserted H1 2027 order timing is inferred rather than confirmed.

action_horizon.action: Reassess monetization and guidance durability at the next earnings release.

contradiction_notes: Strong reported financials coexist with a cited decline in daily active users.
units.evidence_sought: Revenue, earnings, guidance, unit economics, the secondary metric’s causal link to monetization, and competitive evidence.
units.falsifier: The secondary metric subsequently impairs revenue growth, margins, or guidance.
units.inference: Assess whether the allegedly negative metric changes the earnings-power thesis instead of accepting a headline narrative.

raw_codes.label: Fundamentals versus market narrative
raw_codes.rationale: Strong financial data conflict with the stated explanation for the decline.

raw_codes.label: Monetization sensitivity
raw_codes.rationale: Tests whether the secondary metric has economic relevance.

units.trigger: Reported earnings and forward guidance exceed expectations while market reaction focuses on a weaker secondary operating metric.
uncertainty_notes: The causal explanation for the share-price decline is not established.

action_horizon.action: Map each spending category to capacity-constrained suppliers and monitor allocation.

units.evidence_sought: Updated aggregate capex, buyer-specific spending, supplier order data, capacity constraints, and valuation relative to earnings.
units.falsifier: Capex is redirected away from relevant inputs, capacity becomes abundant, or supplier economics do not improve.
units.inference: Synchronized capex can identify upstream bottlenecks likely to receive incremental capital and pricing power.

raw_codes.label: Aggregate capex to bottleneck suppliers
raw_codes.rationale: Uses broad spending as a supply-chain demand signal.

raw_codes.label: Theme-level screening
raw_codes.rationale: The post supports a thematic map, not a company-specific conclusion.

units.trigger: Aggregate capital-spending guidance rises across several large buyers that also cite shortages or pricing power.
uncertainty_notes: The post does not quantify how much capex reaches each named bottleneck.

action_horizon.action: Track whether shortage evidence produces backlog, price increases, and capacity commitments.

units.evidence_sought: Shipment-versus-demand data, fab utilization, customer lead times, competitor capacity, and pricing behavior by product.
units.falsifier: Supply additions close the gap without pricing power or customer demand falls.
units.inference: A quantified shortfall may support a chokepoint thesis, especially when shortages broaden across adjacent products.

raw_codes.label: Industry-executive evidence
raw_codes.rationale: The observation is attributed to an operating executive.

raw_codes.label: Supply-gap pricing power
raw_codes.rationale: Scarcity must translate into economics to matter.

units.trigger: An industry executive quantifies a material supply gap and identifies product segments where it is spreading.
uncertainty_notes: The quoted shortage estimate is a single executive’s statement.

action_horizon.action: Monitor allocation, contract-price resets, and incremental capacity announcements.

units.evidence_sought: Contracted capacity, allocation percentages, inventory, spot and contract pricing, new capacity, and end-demand forecasts.
units.falsifier: Customers cancel allocations, inventories build, or final shipment prices decline.
units.inference: Pre-sold capacity plus rationing creates potential future pricing power, but price realization remains open.

raw_codes.label: Allocation and sold-out data
raw_codes.rationale: Capacity commitments and rationing are the core evidence.

raw_codes.label: Deferred price-setting
raw_codes.rationale: Final pricing will determine scarcity monetization.

units.trigger: Suppliers report future capacity sold out, customer allocations below requests, and prices set near delivery.
uncertainty_notes: The information is attributed to unnamed industry sources.

action_horizon.action: Track rule finalization and supplier qualification.

units.evidence_sought: Draft rule text, implementation date, covered products, exemptions, supplier eligibility, capacity, and customer substitution plans.
units.falsifier: The restriction is abandoned, narrowed, delayed, or non-exempt suppliers cannot replace affected imports.
units.inference: Trade policy can reallocate demand toward eligible suppliers if the proposal becomes enforceable and alternatives can supply it.

raw_codes.label: Trade-policy supply shift
raw_codes.rationale: The proposed ban is the stated catalyst.

raw_codes.label: Implementation and substitution
raw_codes.rationale: Both are required for the read-through.

units.trigger: A proposed import restriction would disadvantage a regional supply base while exempting alternatives.
uncertainty_notes: The policy is described as a draft rather than a final rule.

action_horizon.action: Track contract conversion into backlog and milestone delivery.

units.evidence_sought: Award terms, funding status, backlog treatment, delivery schedule, margins, execution requirements, and cancellation provisions.
units.falsifier: Funding is withdrawn, milestones slip materially, or contract economics are unfavorable.
units.inference: A contract award improves revenue visibility only to the extent that funding, performance, and economics are confirmed.

raw_codes.label: Government contract award
raw_codes.rationale: The award is a discrete commercial catalyst.

raw_codes.label: Milestone realization
raw_codes.rationale: Economic impact depends on execution timing.

units.trigger: A company receives a defined government contract for a specified program.
uncertainty_notes: The chunk does not provide contract duration or margin details.

action_horizon.action: Track progression from testing revenue to customer production ramps.

units.evidence_sought: Purchase orders, revenue recognition, yield data, qualification progress, customer production dates, and segment guidance.
units.falsifier: Testing activity fails to convert to production orders or yield problems delay ramps.
units.inference: Initial testing revenue is an early adoption marker; scale-volume claims should be separated from current commercial evidence.

raw_codes.label: Delay narrative versus operational evidence
raw_codes.rationale: Operational POs and revenue are used to test delay claims.

raw_codes.label: Testing before volume production
raw_codes.rationale: The post distinguishes early test revenue from later scale-up.

units.trigger: Management rejects delay claims while reporting purchase orders and initial revenue in an emerging technology.
uncertainty_notes: Management statements do not independently verify broader industry timelines.

action_horizon.action: Monitor qualification and production-ramp milestones.

units.evidence_sought: JDA scope, named customer commitment, qualification status, partner roles, production timing, and supplier purchase orders.
units.falsifier: The JDA does not convert into production, the hyperscaler program is cancelled, or the inferred supplier is not selected.
units.inference: A customer-linked development agreement can expand addressable market for the company and upstream suppliers, subject to program conversion.

raw_codes.label: Joint development program
raw_codes.rationale: The JDA is the commercial entry point.

raw_codes.label: Program to upstream supplier
raw_codes.rationale: The supplier read-through is an additional inference.

units.trigger: A company enters a joint development agreement tied to a hyperscaler deployment and claims use of existing manufacturing infrastructure.
uncertainty_notes: The likely supplier and architecture are inferred, not confirmed.

action_horizon.action: Use the IPO outcome to test the sector halo hypothesis.

units.evidence_sought: Derivative-market liquidity and methodology, IPO terms, comparable-company moves, lockups, and post-listing trading behavior.
units.falsifier: The IPO trades poorly or peer valuations do not respond after controlling for market moves.
units.inference: A strong leader listing may create a sector-attention catalyst, but derivative indications are weak valuation anchors.

raw_codes.label: Peer-valuation halo
raw_codes.rationale: The proposed mechanism is spillover from a leader’s listing.

raw_codes.label: Low-confidence proxy
raw_codes.rationale: Pre-IPO derivative prices are presented as imperfect evidence.

units.trigger: Derivative-market implied valuation materially exceeds a planned IPO valuation for a sector leader.
uncertainty_notes: The relationship between perpetual prices and IPO opens is anecdotal.

action_horizon.action: Update the model when qualification and capacity milestones are achieved.

units.evidence_sought: Qualification completion, capacity additions, output rates, customer demand, bottleneck inputs, gross-margin progression, and CPO production timing.
units.falsifier: Qualification fails, facilities slip, utilization misses, or external supply removes the shortage.
units.inference: Operating milestones can support a multi-stage revenue-ramp model, with capacity and input constraints defining the ceiling.

raw_codes.label: Operational milestone set
raw_codes.rationale: The argument combines qualification, capacity, and demand observations.

raw_codes.label: Vertical-integration advantage
raw_codes.rationale: Internal laser production is positioned as protection from shortage.

units.trigger: A producer reports customer qualification, capacity expansion, vertical integration, demand above supply, and a future product ramp.
uncertainty_notes: Several conclusions about sector-wide read-through extend beyond company-specific evidence.

action_horizon.action: Check subsequent bookings and price realization.

units.falsifier: Peer declines are explained by unrelated issuer events or the focal company materially diverges from the basket after controlling for market movement.
units.inference: A synchronous peer selloff is more consistent with a sector-level de-risking than an isolated issuer event.

raw_codes.label: Peer-basket relative analysis
raw_codes.rationale: The display supplies several relevant peers in the same hardware theme.

raw_codes.label: Cross-sectional price breadth
raw_codes.rationale: The observation is co-movement across peer securities.

units.trigger: Multiple listed photonics and optical-component names decline together in one market snapshot.
uncertainty_notes: The screenshot is incomplete and several names or prices are OCR-degraded.

action_horizon.action: Hold any policy-driven thesis until formal authority and follow-through are established.

units.evidence_sought: Successor appointment, formal scope of authority, stated policy continuity, and subsequent rulemaking or enforcement actions.
units.falsifier: The outgoing official retains the same operative authority or policy actions proceed unchanged under a clearly identified successor.
units.inference: Personnel moves matter only insofar as they alter institutional authority or the policy implementation path.

raw_codes.label: Authority verification
raw_codes.rationale: The analytical relevance depends on the person's actual mandate, not the headline title.

raw_codes.label: Policy-continuity check
raw_codes.rationale: Continuity of authority and action would negate an inferred policy shift.

units.trigger: A senior policy official moves from an executive role to an advisory role.
uncertainty_notes: No successor or policy consequence is supplied.

action_horizon.action: Use it to set the required confirmation threshold and position-risk posture before the cash session.

units.evidence_sought: Magnitude, direction, liquidity, timing, and whether cash-market and broader cross-asset measures confirm the move.
units.falsifier: Cash markets and wider risk indicators fail to confirm the futures signal after the open.
units.inference: The dashboard is a rapid risk-regime read, but not evidence for a single security without broader confirmation.

raw_codes.label: Cross-asset risk-regime lens
raw_codes.rationale: It combines futures from distinct risk assets.

raw_codes.label: Pre-cash-session confirmation
raw_codes.rationale: Futures are most useful for near-term risk assessment ahead of or during market open.

units.trigger: A futures dashboard shows concurrent moves in equity-index, technology-index, and bitcoin contracts.
uncertainty_notes: The dashboard omits context for contract timing and the underlying driver.

action_horizon.action: Treat the claim as unverified and request complete, time-stamped portfolio records before using it as a signal.
action_horizon.horizon: Before any allocation or strategy replication

units.evidence_sought: Full holdings, position sizes, cash flows, leverage, realized versus unrealized gains, and independently dated statements.
units.falsifier: A complete, independently verifiable record shows the same return with disclosed capital base, flows, and risk exposures.
units.inference: Percentage-return claims without capital-base and cash-flow context are not sufficient evidence of investable performance or replicability.

raw_codes.label: Performance-claim provenance
raw_codes.rationale: The move tests whether a cited track record can be audited.

raw_codes.label: Return-context requirement
raw_codes.rationale: Full records can falsify the concern that the reported return is misleading.

units.trigger: A portfolio-performance claim is paired with an apparently deliberate omission of total portfolio value.
uncertainty_notes: The excerpt is social-media commentary and does not establish intent or the underlying portfolio facts.

action_horizon.action: Define escalation scenarios and monitor the stated trigger rather than trading the quote in isolation.

units.evidence_sought: Official policy statements, force movements, allied responses, and whether the stated threshold is crossed.
units.falsifier: The speaker or government explicitly retracts the condition, or subsequent actions show the condition does not govern policy.
units.inference: Conditional escalation rhetoric should be tracked as scenario risk, not treated as an executed policy change.

raw_codes.label: Conditional geopolitical escalation
raw_codes.rationale: The statement identifies an event threshold tied to potential action.

raw_codes.label: Rhetoric versus implementation
raw_codes.rationale: The evidence is a statement, not confirmation of policy execution.

units.trigger: A political leader publicly signals willingness to escalate military action after a specified threshold event.
uncertainty_notes: The quoted language is OCR-degraded and lacks full interview context.

action_horizon.action: Quantify affected capacity and watch market evidence before considering aluminum-chain exposure.

units.evidence_sought: Verified outage duration, plant capacity, inventory, alternative supply, and aluminum price or spread response.
units.falsifier: The plant resumes promptly, capacity is readily replaced, or pricing shows no persistent supply effect.
units.inference: Damage to a significant processing asset can create a physical-supply shock whose investment relevance depends on duration and replaceability.

raw_codes.label: Industrial supply disruption
raw_codes.rationale: The reported damage is a potential physical-supply catalyst.

raw_codes.label: Aluminum-chain exposure
raw_codes.rationale: The possible value capture lies with beneficiaries of tighter aluminum supply.

units.trigger: A major aluminum plant is reported damaged in a military strike.
uncertainty_notes: The report does not state damage extent, capacity, or operational status.

action_horizon.action: Test the linkage between physical LNG disruption and company cash-flow sensitivity before extending the momentum signal.

units.evidence_sought: LNG benchmark prices, cargo flows, contractual exposure, plant utilization, and company-specific earnings sensitivity.
units.falsifier: LNG prices and flows remain unaffected, or the company's contractual structure leaves its earnings insensitive to spot-market tightness.
units.inference: The price move is a hypothesis that the market expects value capture from tighter global gas and energy logistics, not proof of the mechanism.

raw_codes.label: LNG exposure to energy disruption
raw_codes.rationale: The company is an identifiable potential beneficiary of global LNG tightness.

raw_codes.label: Price move as hypothesis
raw_codes.rationale: Observed performance should be explained with operating exposure rather than assumed causal.

units.trigger: An LNG-focused company shows strong year-to-date price performance amid regional energy-supply risk.
uncertainty_notes: The chart alone does not attribute the return to any event or establish earnings sensitivity.

action_horizon.action: Model net commodity sensitivity before interpreting the price chart as a durable energy-shock beneficiary signal.

units.evidence_sought: Oil-price sensitivity, upstream volumes, refining offsets, hedges, and confirmation of an actual supply disruption.
units.falsifier: Commodity prices normalize, supply is not disrupted, or refining and hedging offsets negate the expected earnings benefit.
units.inference: The move suggests expected value capture from higher hydrocarbons prices, but integrated businesses can have offsetting exposures.

raw_codes.label: Integrated-energy price sensitivity
raw_codes.rationale: The relevant question is the issuer's net capture of an energy-price shock.

raw_codes.label: Price performance is not attribution
raw_codes.rationale: The chart shows an outcome but not its driver.

units.trigger: An integrated oil company shows strong year-to-date price performance amid regional energy-supply risk.
uncertainty_notes: The excerpt contains no earnings or operating-exposure data.

action_horizon.action: Monitor authorization and deployment evidence as escalation gates; retain scenario-based rather than directional assumptions.

units.evidence_sought: Formal authorization, logistics deployments, operational orders, and independent confirmation of scope and timing.
units.falsifier: Plans are not authorized, are abandoned, or force-posture evidence contradicts operational preparation.
units.inference: Planning raises the probability distribution of escalation but is not confirmation that an operation will occur.

raw_codes.label: Contingent military-operation catalyst
raw_codes.rationale: The report describes a potential action with a clear approval condition.

raw_codes.label: Plans are not execution
raw_codes.rationale: The conditional wording requires confirmation.

units.trigger: Reported Pentagon preparation for possible ground operations contingent on presidential approval.
uncertainty_notes: The report gives no corroborating evidence or approval decision.

action_horizon.action: Update the custom-chip thesis only after quantifying deployment and economics; monitor follow-on customer usage.

units.evidence_sought: Customer deployment scale, workload share, chip supply capacity, contract economics, unit performance, and repeat-use evidence.
units.falsifier: The workloads are immaterial, temporary, subsidized, or later shift away from the custom chips.
units.inference: Named production training adoption is stronger validation of a custom-chip narrative than aspirational product claims, though it does not establish revenue magnitude.

raw_codes.label: Customer-adoption validation
raw_codes.rationale: The reported use by a major customer is a tangible adoption catalyst.

raw_codes.label: Primary-executive attribution
raw_codes.rationale: The claim is attributed to the provider's CEO and should be verified at source.

raw_codes.label: Custom-chip economics
raw_codes.rationale: Value capture depends on scaled, economic deployments rather than technical adoption alone.

units.trigger: A major cloud provider's CEO states that a leading AI developer trains its newest models on the provider's custom chips.
uncertainty_notes: The excerpt does not quantify usage, financial impact, or exclusivity and includes OCR errors.

action_horizon.action: Verify backlog quality and conversion assumptions before treating the headline as a multi-year earnings catalyst.

units.evidence_sought: Company disclosures, backlog definition, cancellation terms, capacity plans, customer concentration, margins, and conversion into revenue.
units.falsifier: The report is not confirmed, bookings are cancellable or low-margin, capacity cannot be delivered, or later disclosures show weaker backlog conversion.
units.inference: A multi-year booked pipeline can improve revenue visibility and support a demand thesis, but backlog quality and capacity economics determine its value.

raw_codes.label: Multi-year backlog validation
raw_codes.rationale: The claim concerns durable order visibility.

raw_codes.label: Capacity-financing requirement
raw_codes.rationale: Fulfilling a long-duration pipeline may require capital investment and affects returns.

raw_codes.label: Backlog-quality test
raw_codes.rationale: Cancellability, margin, and conversion are explicit conditions that could negate the thesis.

units.trigger: A reported AI-driven order pipeline is fully booked through 2028 for an optical-component company.
uncertainty_notes: The statement is attributed to a media report rather than a company filing and gives no backlog value or terms.

action_horizon.action: Monitor for confirmed defense-commercial developments rather than act on the statement alone.

units.evidence_sought: Procurement awards, contract announcements, military adoption evidence, and company disclosures confirming commercial follow-through.
units.falsifier: No subsequent contract, deployment, or revenue evidence emerges, or management disclaims material defense exposure.
units.inference: The endorsement may increase attention to the company, but durable value requires verified conversion into defense revenue.

raw_codes.label: Political validation requires commercial confirmation
raw_codes.rationale: The statement is treated as an attention catalyst whose investment relevance depends on operational follow-through.

raw_codes.label: No procurement conversion
raw_codes.rationale: Absent tangible defense adoption, the endorsement does not support a durable thesis.

units.trigger: A public statement by a political leader praises a company's military capability.
uncertainty_notes: The statement alone does not establish the scale or timing of any economic benefit.

action_horizon.action: Investigate whether the ownership link is accompanied by durable commercial integration.

units.evidence_sought: Supply agreements, customer concentration, capacity commitments, governance rights, and subsequent commercial transactions between the parties.
units.falsifier: The investment has no associated supply, technology, or capacity relationship and is later reduced without commercial follow-through.
units.inference: The equity investment can signal strategic alignment, but must be distinguished from a purely financial placement.

raw_codes.label: Strategic ownership linkage
raw_codes.rationale: The disclosed private placement identifies a potential strategic relationship between buyer and supplier.

raw_codes.label: Equity stake to commercial demand
raw_codes.rationale: The move requires verification that ownership translates into economically meaningful demand or access.

units.trigger: A strategic buyer acquires a meaningful equity stake in a specialized supplier through private placement.
uncertainty_notes: The excerpt does not state the buyer's strategic intent or any commercial commitments.

action_horizon.action: Track the announced capacity and CPO ramp for corroborating supply-chain evidence.

units.evidence_sought: Plant construction milestones, customer qualifications, CPO production volumes, packaging orders, and supplier revenue confirmation.
units.falsifier: Plants are delayed, CPO mass production does not begin, or capacity is not supported by customer demand.
units.inference: Capacity expansion and a move to mass production can validate a supply-chain demand inflection, subject to execution and order conversion.

raw_codes.label: Capacity expansion ahead of technology ramp
raw_codes.rationale: The reported expansion is a potential operational catalyst tied to CPO production.

raw_codes.label: Packaging expansion to component demand
raw_codes.rationale: The analytical link is from production capacity to downstream demand for relevant packaging inputs.

units.trigger: A packaging company is reported to expand plant capacity while CPO mass production is expected to begin.
uncertainty_notes: The report does not specify committed customers, utilization, or production volumes.

action_horizon.action: Evaluate pricing power and segment economics; monitor management response to the activist proposal.

units.evidence_sought: Management pricing actions, customer acceptance, segment margins, standalone financial disclosures, and any formal separation process.
units.falsifier: Customers reject price increases, margins do not improve, or management demonstrates that separation would not create incremental value.
units.inference: A scarce enabling material may have greater pricing power and standalone value than consolidated reporting reveals.

raw_codes.label: Under-monetized bottleneck input
raw_codes.rationale: The thesis centers on extracting more value from a critical input to advanced packaging.

raw_codes.label: Activist-led repricing and separation
raw_codes.rationale: Price action and a potential carve-out are identified as pathways to realize value.

raw_codes.label: Pricing power fails in practice
raw_codes.rationale: The core claim fails if customers or competitive supply prevent repricing.

units.trigger: An activist identifies a specialized semiconductor-packaging material as under-monetized, presses for substantial price increases, and advocates separation of the business.
uncertainty_notes: The proposal reflects the activist's view and does not confirm management adoption or customer acceptance.

action_horizon.action: Use the order as a lead and seek confirmation through installation and follow-on demand.

units.evidence_sought: Installation and acceptance timing, additional customer orders, wafer output, utilization, and the purchaser's end-market demand.
units.falsifier: The system is not installed or utilized, the order is cancelled, or no broader demand evidence appears.
units.inference: A production-equipment order is a concrete, though single-customer, indicator of planned capacity investment in the relevant technology.

raw_codes.label: Production-equipment order
raw_codes.rationale: The disclosure records a specific capital-equipment commitment.

raw_codes.label: Equipment order to technology demand
raw_codes.rationale: The inference depends on capacity spending ultimately reflecting commercial demand for quantum-dot wafers.

units.trigger: A quantum-dot wafer producer orders a production-scale epitaxy system to expand production and R&D capacity.
uncertainty_notes: One equipment order does not establish industry-wide demand or the purchaser's utilization.

action_horizon.action: Monitor real-world disruption indicators and reassess exposure as implementation becomes clear.

units.evidence_sought: Official implementation details, shipping and insurance rates, vessel traffic, commodity-price response, and evidence of duration or de-escalation.
units.falsifier: The blockade is not implemented, traffic continues normally, or a durable agreement rapidly restores passage.
units.inference: A blockade can create a near-term logistics and energy shock, but its market implications depend on enforcement and persistence.

raw_codes.label: Geopolitical supply-route disruption
raw_codes.rationale: The announced blockade is a potential catalyst affecting transport and commodity flows.

raw_codes.label: No effective disruption
raw_codes.rationale: The thesis is invalidated if the announcement does not materially alter shipping conditions.

units.trigger: A government leader announces a blockade of a critical shipping chokepoint.
uncertainty_notes: The statement does not establish whether the blockade will be enforceable or sustained.

action_horizon.action: Model dilution and funding runway, then wait for closing and operational milestones before relying on the pivot thesis.

units.evidence_sought: Financing terms and closing, dilution, use of proceeds, asset-sale completion, GPU deployment, customer contracts, and cash burn.
units.falsifier: Financing fails to close, dilution overwhelms the economics, the asset sale fails, or the AI-cloud business does not secure customers.
units.inference: The announced pivot creates a catalyst but also raises financing and execution risk; the capital structure is central to assessing any upside.

raw_codes.label: Convertible financing for business pivot
raw_codes.rationale: The proposed funding facility is integral to both runway and dilution risk.

raw_codes.label: Asset-sale-funded strategic pivot
raw_codes.rationale: The divestiture and new AI-cloud focus are presented as the change mechanism.

raw_codes.label: Financing or execution failure
raw_codes.rationale: Either failure would undermine the announced transformation.

units.trigger: A company announces a convertible financing facility alongside a sale of its legacy business and a pivot to GPU-as-a-Service and AI cloud.
uncertainty_notes: The facility is expected to close rather than confirmed closed, and no economics or customer commitments are provided.

action_horizon.action: Monitor for a catalyst-backed squeeze setup rather than act on short interest alone.

units.evidence_sought: Borrow availability, cost to borrow, days to cover, and the catalyst calendar.
units.falsifier: Short interest falls, borrow conditions ease, or no positive catalyst emerges.
units.inference: Crowded short positioning can amplify a positive-catalyst move, but is not itself a directional thesis.

raw_codes.label: short-interest positioning
raw_codes.rationale: The chart reports a high short-interest level.

raw_codes.label: short-covering amplification
raw_codes.rationale: Crowded shorts can accelerate upside after confirming news.

raw_codes.label: wait for catalyst confirmation
raw_codes.rationale: Positioning alone does not establish entry timing.

units.trigger: Short interest is elevated and rising.
uncertainty_notes: The chart does not identify the issuer or establish borrow conditions.

action_horizon.action: Track formal listing steps and reassess when a definitive announcement is made.

units.evidence_sought: Company confirmation, listing timetable, regulatory filings, and expected investor-access effects.
units.falsifier: The company abandons the evaluation or the contemplated listing does not proceed.
units.inference: A credible dual listing can expand market access and liquidity, creating a discrete catalyst.

raw_codes.label: dual-listing catalyst
raw_codes.rationale: The reported action could change market access and liquidity.

raw_codes.label: confirmatory filing
raw_codes.rationale: A formal filing or announcement is needed to validate the event.

units.trigger: A company is evaluating a potential Nasdaq dual listing.
uncertainty_notes: The report says the listing is being evaluated, not approved.

action_horizon.action: Verify the award in company materials and model conversion of bookings into revenue.

units.evidence_sought: Customer identity or quality, contract terms, revenue-recognition timing, capacity needs, and margin implications.
units.falsifier: The award is non-binding, bookings fail to convert, or guidance does not reflect the reported demand.
units.inference: A production award plus bookings can validate commercial demand and improve forward revenue visibility.

raw_codes.label: hyperscale production award
raw_codes.rationale: Customer adoption and bookings are a potential demand catalyst.

raw_codes.label: bookings-to-revenue conversion
raw_codes.rationale: Economic value depends on conversion, timing, and margins.

raw_codes.label: next earnings validation
raw_codes.rationale: Subsequent reporting can confirm commercial impact.

units.trigger: A company reports a production award from a hyperscale customer and bookings exceeding a stated amount.
uncertainty_notes: The issuer and contractual details are redacted or unclear.

action_horizon.action: Use the post to generate a regulatory diligence checklist; do not treat it as confirmation.

units.evidence_sought: Primary regulatory actions, enforcement timing, legal demand channels, and company-specific product exposure.
units.falsifier: Enforcement does not reduce alternative supply or compliant suppliers do not capture demand.
units.inference: Regulatory removal of gray-market supply could redirect demand toward compliant suppliers, but a social post is only a hypothesis source.

raw_codes.label: social-media thesis
raw_codes.rationale: The claim originates from an individual social-media post.

raw_codes.label: regulatory supply cleanup
raw_codes.rationale: The stated mechanism is demand migration after enforcement.

raw_codes.label: unverified hypothesis
raw_codes.rationale: The causal chain requires primary-source validation.

units.trigger: A social-media post presents a regulatory-cleanup thesis for a product category and named suppliers.
uncertainty_notes: The post offers no primary evidence for the regulatory or company-specific claims.

action_horizon.action: Monitor filing milestones and use disclosed financials for comparable analysis.

units.evidence_sought: Registration filing, audited financials, offering terms, valuation basis, and peer-comparable implications.
units.falsifier: The company delays, cancels, or materially reprices the offering.
units.inference: An impending IPO can create a valuation and ecosystem reference point, but preparation alone is not a completed transaction.

raw_codes.label: IPO preparation
raw_codes.rationale: A prospective public listing is a discrete market event.

raw_codes.label: comparable valuation
raw_codes.rationale: Public disclosures can inform peer valuation analysis.

raw_codes.label: registration milestone
raw_codes.rationale: A filing provides a stronger confirmation point than a report of preparation.

units.trigger: A semiconductor company is reported to be preparing a public listing with a multibillion-dollar target.
uncertainty_notes: The text is incomplete and does not provide offering terms or a confirmed timetable.

action_horizon.action: Check official policy language and monitor user-conversion or churn indicators after rollout.

units.evidence_sought: Official policy, rollout scope, affected geographies, conversion data, and alternative access paths.
units.falsifier: The requirement is limited, optional, reversed, or conversion remains unaffected.
units.inference: Mandatory identity verification can reduce signup conversion or alter the addressable user base; it is an adoption-friction variable.

raw_codes.label: subscription identity gate
raw_codes.rationale: The capture shows a KYC-like verification step before subscription.

raw_codes.label: verification to conversion friction
raw_codes.rationale: The potential effect operates through signup friction.

raw_codes.label: limited rollout
raw_codes.rationale: A narrow or optional policy would weaken the adoption-risk inference.

units.trigger: A subscription flow reportedly introduces government-ID and camera-based identity verification.
uncertainty_notes: The capture does not establish whether the requirement is universal or permanent.

action_horizon.action: Track confirmation and production-volume evidence before underwriting revenue.

units.evidence_sought: Company confirmation, program design-win status, production schedule, volume commitments, and revenue concentration.
units.falsifier: The discussions end, the programs are not awarded, or they do not reach production.
units.inference: A confirmed custom-chip engagement could provide a material AI-infrastructure demand catalyst for the supplier.

raw_codes.label: custom-chip design engagement
raw_codes.rationale: The alleged collaboration could create supplier demand.

raw_codes.label: production-volume conversion
raw_codes.rationale: Supplier value depends on design wins converting to production volume.

raw_codes.label: reported discussions
raw_codes.rationale: The source describes talks rather than a confirmed agreement.

units.trigger: A report says Google is discussing two AI-chip programs with Marvell, including a TPU-related design.
uncertainty_notes: The report attributes the information to unnamed people and describes discussions, not a contract.

action_horizon.action: Validate the relationship and identify which supplier captures manufacturing and packaging economics.

units.evidence_sought: Primary company disclosures, foundry role, production qualification, packaging content, and revenue allocation.
units.falsifier: The reported partnership is incorrect, the accelerator is delayed, or manufacturing is sourced elsewhere.
units.inference: If confirmed, a CPO accelerator design can create a supply-chain demand path for the stated manufacturing partner.

raw_codes.label: accelerator design to foundry demand
raw_codes.rationale: The claim connects product architecture to supplier demand.

raw_codes.label: manufacturing and packaging economics
raw_codes.rationale: Participation does not establish the amount of supplier value capture.

raw_codes.label: reported collaboration
raw_codes.rationale: The statement requires primary-source confirmation.

units.trigger: A report links an accelerator program's co-packaged-optics design to a named foundry.
uncertainty_notes: The report does not establish contract scope, volume, or economic terms.

action_horizon.action: Test the directional thesis against production telemetry and identify infrastructure suppliers exposed to CPU and orchestration demand.

units.evidence_sought: Measured workload traces, CPU and GPU utilization, latency decomposition, and the architectures used in production.
units.falsifier: Measured agent workloads remain GPU-bound or CPU processing does not materially constrain end-to-end latency.
units.inference: Rising workflow action complexity can increase the importance of CPU-side processing and orchestration relative to GPU compute.

raw_codes.label: agent complexity to CPU bottleneck
raw_codes.rationale: The exhibit specifies a workload-to-bottleneck causal relationship.

raw_codes.label: workload architecture
raw_codes.rationale: The analytical frame is compute allocation by application type.

raw_codes.label: directional estimates
raw_codes.rationale: The source explicitly says the splits are estimates rather than measured benchmarks.

units.trigger: A research exhibit estimates that agentic AI workloads shift the latency bottleneck toward CPU processing as tool use increases.
uncertainty_notes: The exhibit labels its workload splits as directional estimates, not measured benchmarks.

action_horizon.action: Map directly named components and monitor implementation actions before treating the determination as revenue.

units.evidence_sought: The covered components, stated supply gap, and any resulting procurement, funding, or capacity actions.
units.falsifier: No follow-on funding, procurement, or capacity action occurs, or the named components are excluded from implementation.
units.inference: A formal national-defense designation can create a policy-driven demand and capacity catalyst across named supply-chain layers.

raw_codes.label: Policy designation catalyst
raw_codes.rationale: The determination identifies strategic need and a supply shortfall.

raw_codes.label: Policy to supply-chain demand
raw_codes.rationale: The move links formal government action to potential demand for covered inputs.

units.trigger: A formal government determination identifies grid infrastructure and its upstream inputs as essential and insufficiently supplied.

action_horizon.action: Avoid or reduce exposure until operating progress and financing discipline are independently verified.

units.evidence_sought: Financial losses, share issuance history, insider or large-holder sales, and evidence of durable operating improvement.
units.falsifier: Audited results show sustained improvement, dilution ceases, and major-holder selling is not present.
units.inference: Price momentum alone is a weak basis for ownership when dilution, weak fundamentals, and potential distribution by holders coexist.

raw_codes.label: Fundamentals-versus-momentum check
raw_codes.rationale: The thesis challenges a rally with losses, dilution, and holder behavior.

raw_codes.label: Exit before confirmation of crowded reversal
raw_codes.rationale: The stated move is to sell while the speculative rise remains intact.

units.trigger: A sharply rising, speculation-led stock is described as loss-making, repeatedly dilutive, and subject to selling by major holders.
uncertainty_notes: The claims are presented as an article summary and are not independently corroborated in the packet.

action_horizon.action: Credit only confirmed orders and wait for disclosed conversion or shipment evidence before underwriting the pending customers.

units.evidence_sought: Purchase orders, customer names where disclosed, order size, shipment timing, and conversion of pending discussions.
units.falsifier: The prospective manufacturers place material orders or are formally announced as customers.
units.inference: Separate confirmed orders from unconfirmed customer conversations; pending counterparties are not yet commercial validation.

raw_codes.label: Confirmed versus prospective customer evidence
raw_codes.rationale: The statement distinguishes an existing order from companies that have not responded.

raw_codes.label: Do not promote conversations to revenue
raw_codes.rationale: The inference limits confidence to evidence already confirmed.

units.trigger: A company officer reports orders from one customer while saying other prospective manufacturing customers have not yet responded.
uncertainty_notes: The text is an attributed media statement rather than primary order documentation.

action_horizon.action: Trace the named inputs into exposed manufacturing processes and monitor availability before assuming output can scale.

units.evidence_sought: The affected process steps, inventory duration, supplier qualification constraints, and downstream production interruptions.
units.falsifier: Qualified alternative supply is readily available and downstream production continues without constraint.
units.inference: Seemingly low-profile chemical inputs can become binding constraints for electronic-material production.

raw_codes.label: Specialty chemical to electronics output
raw_codes.rationale: The passage connects solvent availability to electronic-material production.

raw_codes.label: Supply bottleneck
raw_codes.rationale: Insufficient inputs can constrain manufacturing throughput.

units.trigger: Specific solvents used in electronic materials are identified as insufficient.

action_horizon.action: Monitor price, lead-time, and volume data together rather than extrapolating a headline price change.

units.evidence_sought: Vendor pricing actions, channel inventories, lead times, unit volumes, and whether price increases persist.
units.falsifier: Lead times normalize, inventories rise, or pricing reverses without sustained demand growth.
units.inference: A price increase can signal tight supply, but it must be decomposed into demand strength, production constraints, and vendor pricing power.

raw_codes.label: Supply-demand pricing signal
raw_codes.rationale: The headline attributes price movement to demand and a production bottleneck.

raw_codes.label: Price persistence check
raw_codes.rationale: The move requires corroboration before treating price inflation as durable.

uncertainty_notes: The headline provides no underlying data on price coverage or duration.

units.evidence_sought: Funded accounts, assets, trading activity, retention, revenue per account, and acquisition costs.
units.falsifier: New accounts are unfunded, inactive, or fail to translate into assets, activity, or revenue.
units.inference: Account growth is an early activity signal, not a complete earnings signal, because account quality and monetization can differ.

raw_codes.label: Operating KPI
raw_codes.rationale: Quarterly account additions are a measurable business metric.

raw_codes.label: Monetization follow-through
raw_codes.rationale: The move distinguishes customer acquisition from economic capture.

units.trigger: A broker reports a record quarterly increase in accounts.
uncertainty_notes: The total-account chart does not provide funded-account or revenue detail.

action_horizon.action: Treat the financing as a balance-sheet risk signal and monitor final terms and collateral disclosures.

units.falsifier: The financing is not completed, has conservative non-recourse terms, or is supported by demonstrably liquid collateral.
units.inference: Debt secured by illiquid private equity can add refinancing and mark-to-market fragility even when the underlying stake appears valuable.

raw_codes.label: Margin financing against private shares
raw_codes.rationale: The reported transaction uses leverage secured by a private holding.

raw_codes.label: Collateral-liquidity risk
raw_codes.rationale: The risk depends on collateral valuation and financing terms.

units.trigger: A large margin loan is reportedly being sought against privately held shares.
uncertainty_notes: The report describes a sought loan, not a confirmed completed financing.
